thread:
sam: Quick sync — we need a concrete compatibility gate plan for v2 deprecations. Who's owning the SDK side and the canary rollout?

marta: I can own SDK release coordination. plan: patch -> minor -> major. need dates and migration docs.

kevin: I can own server-side shim and gate toggles. will add a canary flag in proxy.

jen: FYI infra has a quota change that may affect canary throughput next week. pinging eng-infra. :spiral_calendar: 172.

alex: Can we list the exact endpoints being deprecated? I only have a partial list.

sam: Main ones: /v1/generate, /v1/chat_stream, /v1/embeddings (legacy params). Also old auth header: X-API-Key deprecated.

marta: For SDK: propose a 3-stage rollout — warn header + runtime warning (1.0.0), opt-in v2 default (1.1.0), forced switch with removal (2.0.0). docs and changelog must show migration snippets.

kevin: For canary: will create a header override: `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` to exercise legacy path. adding small snippet for proxy route: ```nginx
# proxy canary toggle
map $http_x_redwood_compat $legacy_backend {
  default upstream_v2;
  "v1" upstream_v1;
}
```

jen: SDK release windows? we should avoid EOD Friday. propose Tuesday mornings.

marta: Tuesday works. I want automated smoke tests that hit both v1 and v2 for parity. can anyone write migration prompts?

alex: I'll add a prompt suite for chat+stream parity and a basic embedding equivalence set. will drop PRs.

kevin: Also need a matrix: model versions, sequence length, quantized vs fp. I'll add to the internal runbook.

sam: Ownership checklist: SDK (marta), Proxy + toggles (kevin), Prompts + tests (alex), Infra quota visibility (jen). Anything missing?

marta: Docs and changelog (marta + alex). Release notes template in repo.

jen: I'll open a ticket with eng-infra for canary autoscale guardrails — cc @eng-infra.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: feature-flag toggles should be behind `feature/v2_compat_gates` and require a release note on merge.

kevin: Will create the feature flag and the proxy PR. target: feature branch by end of day Thursday.

sam: Timeline proposal: week 0: announce deprecation + migration guide; week 1: SDK patch with warnings; week 3: canary toggle + limited traffic; week 5: increase traffic and start enforcement window; week 8: removal. Thoughts?

marta: timeline OK but add a pre-canary smoke run (week 2) and a rollback plan.

alex: Agree. I'll script quick rollback checks to validate behavior.

kevin: I'll add a fallback policy in the router: if v2 errors > 5% in 10m, switch affected routes back to v1 for 30m.

sam: Perfect. Action items: each owner create PR for runbook + test matrix by EOD Tuesday. I'll compile and send exec summary. :thumbsup:

marta: On it.

jen: adding infra ticket now.

alex: PR incoming later today for prompts.

kevin: proxy PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4123 — initial toggle + nginx map. feedback welcome.

sam: Thanks team — we'll reconvene async here. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @oncall.
